propositions: normalize_ci_conclusion.sh must be ported to a stdlib-only Python entry point while maintaining exact CLI-level behavior for the f(CONCLUSION, FAILURE_OBSERVED) -> {success, failure, cancelled} contract

The existing subprocess-driven contract test in tests/scripts/test_normalize_ci_conclusion.py must be re-pointed at the Python entry point with its full case table preserved and new direct unit tests added
The gerrit-verify.yaml workflow must update its sparse-checkout path from scripts/normalize_ci_conclusion.sh to the new .py file and update the invocation accordingly
The ported function must implement fail-closed behavior: empty/unrecognized CONCLUSION values and skipped with FAILURE_OBSERVED=true both map to failure
The Python entry point must support CLI invocation via environment variables (CONCLUSION, FAILURE_OBSERVED) without requiring the package to be installed
